root.description: The scribe data directory, an absolute path (the CLI's ~/.scribe). The sandbox grants access to it alone. The default, /var/tmp, means unset: every tool answers not_configured until it is set.

transcripts.description: Claude Code's projects directory, an absolute path (~/.claude/projects, or $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/projects). scribe.session-pass reads the transcripts of sessions switched on with /scribe on there; until it is set (the default is empty), it answers not_configured.

claude_program.description: The claude program the model tools run, an absolute path (for example ~/.local/bin/claude) for a launcher whose PATH holds no claude, such as the Orbit clock's on macOS. Empty (the default) runs claude from the call's PATH. A relative path is refused with not_configured.

task_workspaces.description: Workspaces whose Orbit tasks ask reads (orbit.search's workspaces), such as the one holding orchestration tasks. Empty: the workspace the call is bound to. Orbit refuses a federated search inside a managed run.
